chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, from Ali ibn al-Mu'alla, from Yahya ibn Ahmad, from Abu Muhammad al-Maysami, from Rumayy ibn Zurara, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said in a speech of his: 'Indeed! The one who is fair with the people from himself, Allah would not increase him in anything except for honour'.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of being fair to others starting with oneself?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi’s chapter on justice, this chain of narration links Imam Ali’s wisdom through the prominent scholar Al-Mithami, emphasizing that self-accountability is the foundation of social equity. In Shia tradition, this 'fairness to oneself' implies judging one’s own actions with the same rigor applied to others, thereby preventing hypocrisy and inviting divine elevation (izz).

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ibrahim Bin Muhammad Al Saqafy, from Ali Bin Al Moalla, from Yahya Bin Ahmad, from Abu Muhammad Al Maysami, from Rowmiyyi Bin Zurara, from his father, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said in a speech of his<sup>asws</sup>: ‘Indeed! The one is fair with the people from himself, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would not Increase him in anything except for honour’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi from Ali ibn Mu’alla from Yahya ibn Ahmad Fadl ibn Shadhan abu Muhammad al-Maythami from Rumi ibn Zurara from his father from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Amir al-Mu’minin (Ali ibn abu Talib) (a.s.) has said in one of his speeches, ‘You must note that due to a person’s yielding to justice for people against his own self, Allah increases his respect and honor.’”
